plugins.name: galley
plugins.description: Review a Markdown document in the browser while an agent revises it. The reviewer edits directly and leaves instructions on passages; Revise sends the round; the agent edits the file itself and its changes land. Every round is a version. Bundles galley's tools, the mod that delivers rounds into this session, and the skill that teaches the loop.
